function.name: brain_agent_run
function.description: Scan a folder for DICOM series, run the FreeSurfer brain-health pipeline per subject and generate the population-normative and subtype-specific HTML reports. Returns a run_id; poll brain_agent_status for progress.

root.description: Absolute path of the folder to process

dry_run.description: Only discover and plan, do not run the pipeline

function.name: brain_agent_status
function.description: Return the state of a run: per-subject status (planned/running/done/failed/blocked), logs and report paths.

function.name: brain_agent_list_runs
function.description: List all known runs with per-run subject/done/failed counts.

function.name: brain_agent_report_url
function.description: Return the HTTP URL of a generated HTML report for a subject inside a run.
